description: Run a Kubernetes Job as a Dagster asset via dagster-k8s.

outputs.description: Run a Kubernetes Job as a Dagster asset via dagster-k8s.

cpu_request.description: CPU request (e.g. '500m') -- the guaranteed minimum, as distinct from cpu_limit's ceiling.
cpu_request.label: Cpu Request

memory_request.description: Memory request (e.g. '1Gi') -- the guaranteed minimum, as distinct from memory_limit's ceiling.
memory_request.label: Memory Request

image_pull_policy.label: Image Pull Policy
image_pull_policy.description: Override the image pull policy (e.g. 'Always', 'IfNotPresent', 'Never') -- useful for local testing with kind. Dagster-k8s default: 'Always'.

image_pull_secrets.label: Image Pull Secrets
image_pull_secrets.description: Names of Kubernetes imagePullSecrets to use for this Job's Pod (e.g. ['my-registry-secret']).

service_account_name.label: Service Account Name
service_account_name.description: Kubernetes service account under which to run the Job. Defaults to the cluster's 'default' service account.

volumes.label: Volumes
volumes.description: Raw Kubernetes Volume specs for the Job's Pod. Passed straight through -- not simplified, since volume types vary too much (hostPath, configMap, secret, PVC, ...).

volume_mounts.label: Volume Mounts
volume_mounts.description: Raw Kubernetes VolumeMount specs for the Job's container. Passed straight through.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Raise if the Job takes longer than this many seconds -- enforced natively by dagster-k8s's execute_k8s_job (timeout=), not a client-side watchdog.

partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values (e.g. customers); 'multi' for date × static (e.g. day × customer). Leave empty for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: 0 (default): a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows. 1: include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the partitions definition (defaults to UTC).

partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start Date

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Policy Max Partitions Per Run

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule

args.label: Args
args.description: Container args, appended after the resolved command (not a replacement for it) -- Kubernetes' args field, analogous to Airflow's KubernetesPodOperator arguments.

labels.label: Labels
labels.description: Kubernetes labels applied to the Job's Pod metadata.

node_selector.label: Node Selector
node_selector.description: Kubernetes nodeSelector for the Pod (e.g. {'disktype': 'ssd'}) -- constrains scheduling to nodes with matching labels.

tolerations.label: Tolerations
tolerations.description: Raw Kubernetes Toleration specs for the Pod, e.g. [{'key': 'dedicated', 'operator': 'Equal', 'value': 'ml', 'effect': 'NoSchedule'}]. Pass straight through.

affinity.label: Affinity
affinity.description: Raw Kubernetes Affinity spec for the Pod -- node/pod affinity or anti-affinity rules. Pass straight through -- not simplified, since affinity shapes vary too much.

env_from_config_maps.label: Env From Config Maps
env_from_config_maps.description: Kubernetes ConfigMaps whose contents are injected as env vars into the container. Each entry is either a plain ConfigMap name (string), or an object {name, prefix, optional} for a prefixed and/or optional reference (Kubernetes' envFrom.configMapRef).

env_from_secrets.label: Env From Secrets
env_from_secrets.description: Kubernetes Secrets whose contents are injected as env vars into the container. Same shape as env_from_config_maps (plain name, or {name, prefix, optional}).

kubeconfig_file.label: Kubeconfig File
kubeconfig_file.description: Path to a kubeconfig file for out-of-cluster execution (e.g. a local dev machine or a CI runner outside the target cluster). When set, in-cluster config loading is disabled in favor of this file.

in_cluster.label: In Cluster
in_cluster.description: Force in-cluster service-account config (true) or the default local kubeconfig discovery -- ~/.kube/config or $KUBECONFIG (false) -- when kubeconfig_file is unset. Ignored when kubeconfig_file is set. Leave unset to keep this component's historical default.

kube_context.label: Kube Context
kube_context.description: Select a specific context within kubeconfig_file (for a kubeconfig with multiple cluster contexts). Ignored if kubeconfig_file is unset (in-cluster config has no notion of contexts). Defaults to the kubeconfig's own current-context.

k8s_job_name.label: K8s Job Name
k8s_job_name.description: Override the Kubernetes Job name. Leave unset (recommended): dagster-k8s then derives a name that is already unique per run AND per op/asset. Setting this explicitly is only for when you need a fixed, predictable name -- be aware two steps sharing the same explicit name in the same run will collide.

delete_failed_k8s_jobs.label: Delete Failed K8s Jobs
delete_failed_k8s_jobs.description: Whether to immediately delete a failed Kubernetes Job object (dagster-k8s's own default: True). Set False to leave failed Jobs/Pods in the cluster for inspection -- pair with ttl_seconds_after_finished for automatic cleanup instead of leaving them forever. Only applies to the execute_k8s_job path (use_pipes=False); PipesK8sClient manages bare Pods, not Jobs, and always deletes its Pod on completion regardless of this field.

ttl_seconds_after_finished.label: Ttl Seconds After Finished
ttl_seconds_after_finished.description: Sets the Job's native Kubernetes .spec.ttlSecondsAfterFinished -- the cluster's own TTL controller deletes the finished Job (success OR failure) after this many seconds, regardless of delete_failed_k8s_jobs. Only applies to the execute_k8s_job path (use_pipes=False).

use_pipes.label: Use Pipes
use_pipes.description: Use dagster-k8s's PipesK8sClient instead of execute_k8s_job -- the Airflow KubernetesPodOperator equivalent WITH the Dagster Pipes protocol: the pod streams logs AND structured messages (custom metadata, asset checks, a real materialized value) back live, instead of execute_k8s_job's plain log tailing + a fixed metadata dict after the fact. Requires the container's entrypoint to use the `dagster-pipes` package itself (`with dagster_pipes.open_dagster_pipes() as context: ...`) -- a plain, Pipes-unaware image works with execute_k8s_job (use_pipes=False, the default) but not here.

pipes_extras.label: Pipes Extras
pipes_extras.description: use_pipes=True only: extra key-value data passed to the pod's PipesContext (read inside the container via `context.get_extra(key)`).

name: K8sJobAsset
